summary.description: Ticket title (inline). Required when summary_file is not provided.

summary_file.description: Path to a file whose first non-empty line is used as the ticket title. Takes effect only when summary is absent or empty.

description.description: Ticket description body (inline Markdown). Takes precedence over description_file when both are set.

description_file.description: Path to a Markdown file used as the ticket description body. Used only when description is absent or empty.

parent.description: Parent issue key (e.g. DEMO-123). When set the new issue is created as a child of that ticket.

labels.description: Labels to attach to the created issue.

assignee_account_id.description: Jira Cloud accountId of the assignee. Use the Jira user-search API to resolve a display name to an accountId.
